items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Monk told Bud that same night... when Charlie Parker was there... Monk is gone... Monk has a job... Monk was coming to the Five Spot, to him it was the same as me and ______

ctx.x: Bud Powell, I remember when I -- in the early '50s, I never was quite sure whether he was putting people on that he was not quite there, or whether he was not quite there, and sometimes I wonder if he knew the difference.

Well, Monk told Bud that same night that you were talking about at Birdland, when Charlie Parker was there, he walked over to the table that the both of them and says, I told you guys to act crazy, if you act crazy and get a lot of attention, but I didn't tell you to fall in love with the act. You're really crazy now.
He said that to both Parker and Powell?
